title: super-design audit state
description: Canonical schema for docs/super-design/.audit-state.json — the state file that super-design reads on every run to decide what to re-audit. Derived from docs/compass_artifact_wf-f52f98c2-73c9-4483-b49c-6b080ef7dc92_text_markdown.md sections 5, 10, and 16.

schema_version.description: Semver string for this state file's schema. Major bumps force a full re-audit (see §12 line 934, §10).

skill_version.description: Semver of the super-design skill that wrote this state.

last_audit_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last completed audit (used for freshness cascade: 90d soft, 180d hard).

git_sha_at_audit.description: Git SHA (7–64 hex chars) that HEAD pointed to at audit time. Used as the range-start for next audit's git log (§2.1).

is_shallow_clone.description: True if the repo was a shallow clone at audit time. Signals that __MISSING__ fallback (§6) may need git fetch --unshallow.

theory_doc_sha.description: sha256: of references/design-theory.md. Mismatch forces full re-audit (§9.1).

market_analysis_sha.description: sha256: of the current market-analysis.md output.

tools.description: Versions of the audit toolchain at audit time. Major bumps can invalidate prior findings.

framework.description: Detected framework info. Router/version migration triggers full re-audit (§7).

route_map.description: Canonical route list at audit time. Diff against prior route_map produces new/deleted routes (§7).

pages_audited.description: Per-page hashes + findings (§3, §5). Incremental audits compare these to decide which pages to re-visit.

viewport_hashes.description: Per-viewport hashes (mobile_375/tablet_768/desktop_1280). Each entry may be a bare phash string (back-compat with artifact §10 line 492) or the extended {sha256,phash,png_path} object emitted by hash-pages.sh. Any viewport drift -> re-audit that page.

mask_selectors.description: CSS selectors masked in this page's screenshots (artifact §3.4). Merged from hash-pages.sh defaults + MASK_SELECTORS env.

phash_engine.description: Which engine produced the phash values. `phash:` = sharp-based aHash. `fpr:` = zero-dep PNG fingerprint fallback (exact-match only).

components.description: Map of component path -> xxh3 hash (§8). Source of truth for component-level change detection.

token_hash.description: sha256: hash of the canonicalized design-token map. Mismatch invalidates every page (§9).

import_graph_sha.description: sha256: of the serialized import graph (madge). Used to compute blast radius of component changes.

research_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last sd-research run. Used to decide whether to rerun research (>90d -> refresh).

visual_regression.description: Optional visual-regression config (§16). Absent when user hasn't opted in. Consumed by scripts/visual-regression.sh.

engine.description: Engine chain: scripts/visual-regression.sh tries in order and falls back. `sha256-fallback` = exact-match only, always available.

baseline_dir.description: Where accepted baseline PNGs live. Committed to git (small repos) or stored via LFS/artifacts (large).

current_dir.description: Where hash-pages.sh writes the current run's PNGs. Usually gitignored.

diff_dir.description: Where diff images + results.json are emitted by visual-regression.sh.
